title: Disclaimer – Tax VAT Point
main_content: We have taken considerable care to ensure that the content on this website is in accurate alignment with the enacted and published laws. If anything contained here conflicts with the law, the law shall prevail. Despite our collective efforts, it is possible for errors to occur. If you come across any inaccuracies, mistakes, or discrepancies, please inform us via email at [email protected] . You can mail any suggestions also. Your feedback is greatly appreciated. It is important to note that this website does not constitute an official version of the law or serve as a reference. We do not provide a guarantee for any write-up or content. If you make decisions based on the information on this website, we are not held responsible, as it is assumed that you have made decisions based on your understanding of published laws, references, or gazettes. In case of any conflict between the information on this website and the original Government publications or notifications of laws, rules, regulations, and SROs, the Government publications or notifications shall prevail. Additionally, as per Section 136(2) of the VAT & SD Act 2012 and Section 345(2) of the Income Tax Act 2023, if there is a conflict between the English and Bengali texts, the Bengali text shall prevail.
